## Overview

Overton CRM is an AI-powered real estate CRM platform designed for Indian real estate developers, brokers, mandate firms, and sales teams. The platform helps real estate businesses manage leads, inventory, customer communication, payments, documents, and sales operations from a single system.

## Primary Use Cases

* Real estate developers managing projects, inventory, bookings, and customer payments
* Real estate brokers handling leads from property portals and marketing campaigns
* Mandate firms managing multiple projects and developer relationships
* Sales teams tracking inquiries, follow-ups, site visits, and conversions

## Core Features

* AI Lead Qualification
* AI Priority List
* AI Sales Insights & Reporting
* Inventory Management
* RERA Document Generation
* WhatsApp CRM
* Lead Management
* Site Visit Scheduling
* Stage-wise Payment Tracking
* Call Recording & Activity Tracking
* Role-Based Access Control
* Mobile Access for Sales Teams

## Integrations

Overton CRM supports integrations with:

* 99acres
* MagicBricks
* Housing.com
* Meta Ads
* Google Ads
* WhatsApp Business
* Email Platforms
* Excel & CSV Imports
